# Infinix Hot 20 (X6826B) (`x6826b`)

| | |
|---|---|
| Vendor | Infinix |
| SoC | `mt6768` |
| Configuration | `make x6826b_defconfig` |
| Maintainer | the HakiOS developers (README.md) |
| Repository | [hakios-mt6768](https://github.com/oosexgang/hakios-mt6768) |
| Firmware | `devices/x6826b/pull-firmware.sh` pulls it from your own phone |

## What works

| Part | State | |
|---|---|---|
| display | works | 720x1640, scale 2 (fbscale=2 fbfit=3) |
| touch | works | OmniVision TD4160 over SPI2, firmware sent by the loader (touchscreen=2) |
| buttons | works | power and volume, keypad at 0x10010000 (buttons=2) |
| cpu | works | 4 cores, big cores clocked (cpus=4 mtk_cpufreq=3) |
| gpu | works | Mali-G52 MC2 brought up by the kernel (mali=1); panfrost and Metal drew CoreAnimation with the earlier user space, not yet the common tree's |
| storage | partly | the system image read off the eMMC, read only (emmc_root=1) |
| sensors | partly | accelerometer through the SCP sensor hub, rotation (scp_step=7) |
| wifi | partly | CONNSYS up, WMT channel over BTIF/STP; no network yet (connsys_step=8) |
| bluetooth | no | same CONNSYS as Wi-Fi; HCI over STP not yet |
| audio | no |  |
| battery | no |  |
| haptic | no |  |
| camera | no |  |
| torch | no |  |
| cellular | no |  |
| thermal | no |  |

The state is what has been seen on this device, written down in `devices/x6826b/device.conf`; a part the table does not name has not been looked at.
